land.heroEyebrow: Free · On this phone · Three languages
land.heroH: Papers in plain words. Money you can see.
land.heroP: Saath reads loan and scheme papers so you know what you pay back. Money Lab sits inside the same app, so students can track what comes in, what goes out, and practise a case each week.
land.whyH: A free helper for papers and money, in the language you picked.
land.whyP: Take a photo of a loan slip or a scheme form. Saath finds the numbers, says the cost in plain words, and keeps a checklist of what is still missing. Money Lab is a section of this app — not a second download.

flat-rate.title: The rate is flat, so it looks cheaper than it is
flat-rate.reason: A flat rate charges interest on the full amount for the whole time, even as you repay.

high-fees.title: The fees are high
high-fees.reason: Fees add up to more than 3 percent of the amount borrowed.

high-penalty.title: Paying late is costly
high-penalty.reason: The penalty is sharp if a payment is missed.

no-prepay.title: You cannot close this early
no-prepay.reason: The paper does not let you repay the loan before the end.

blanks.title: Blank spaces still need filling
blanks.reason: Empty fields can be filled in later with terms you have not agreed to.

high-rate.title: This rate is far above the usual range
high-rate.reason: Similar loans are often priced lower than this.
high-rate.reasonYearly: This loan costs about {rate} percent a year.

unclear.title: An important number is missing
unclear.reason: Saath will not guess a figure the paper does not state.

checklist.fees: What is included in the fees, and is any fee taken before I receive the money?
checklist.rate: Is this rate flat or reducing, and what do I pay back in total?
checklist.prepay: Can I repay early, and what does that cost?
checklist.late: What happens, in rupees, if I pay one month late?
checklist.lender: Who do I contact if a charge looks wrong?
checklist.collateral: What exactly am I pledging, and how do I get it back?
checklist.blanks: Which blank spaces will be filled later, and can I initial them now?
checklist.eligibility: Who can receive this support, and what papers are required?
checklist.notALoan: Is this a grant, or does any part have to be repaid?
checklist.documents: Which blanks must I fill myself before I submit this?

intro.eyebrow: Free · For any phone · English, Hindi, Marathi
intro.h1: Understand a paper before you sign it.
intro.lead: Saath reads loan and scheme papers aloud and tells you, in plain words, what you will really pay. Inside it, Money Lab helps students learn to handle money, one minute a day.
intro.heroNote: No email. No phone number. Everything stays on this phone.
intro.mockFlag: The paper says 13%, but that is a flat rate. The real cost is much higher.
intro.mockAsk: Questions to ask before you sign
intro.whoT: Made for the moments that matter
intro.w2: Applying for a scholarship or scheme
intro.w3: A form in a language you don’t read well
intro.w4: Learning to handle your own money
intro.featH: One app for your papers and your money.
intro.featP: Saath has four parts. You can open each one from the bar at the bottom of the screen.
intro.f1P: Take a photo of a loan or scheme paper. Saath finds the amount, the interest, the fees and the late-payment rules, and explains them simply.
intro.f1b1: The total you pay back, shown big
intro.f1b2: The real yearly cost, fees included
intro.f2P: Every result and every lesson can be read aloud in English, Hindi or Marathi.
intro.f2b1: Helpful if reading is slow or tiring
intro.f2b2: Play one part or the whole page
intro.f3P: From The Skyward Project. Note what comes in and what goes out, and practise money decisions a little every day.
intro.f3b1: A simple tracker and savings goal
intro.f3b2: One question a day, with a streak
intro.f4P: Short lessons on budgets, EMIs, credit scores, UPI safety, scams, insurance, scholarships and tax.
intro.f4b2: Tap any word to see what it means
intro.howA: When someone gives you a paper to sign
intro.a1P: Lay the paper flat in good light. Saath tells you if the photo is blurry or dark.
intro.a2P: Saath shows the amount, interest and fees it found. Fix anything that looks wrong, like checking a bill.
intro.a3P: See the total you pay back, the real yearly cost, and what happens if you pay late.
intro.a4P: Use the list of questions for the lender. Share the summary with family if you want a second opinion.
intro.howBP: Small steps add up. Money Lab keeps it light, so you come back tomorrow.
intro.b2: Note what you spent or got
intro.tryNote: Not sure yet? Inside the app you can try three sample papers first: a personal loan, a gold loan and a scheme form.
intro.privP: Saath reads photos on your phone. It does not keep them, and it does not send your money notes anywhere.
intro.p1: No email or phone number needed
intro.p2: Photos of papers are not stored
intro.a1: Yes. There are no ads, no fees and no paid version. It is made by students of The Skyward Project.
intro.a2: Only the first time, to load the app and its reading tools. After that, most of Saath works without a connection.
intro.q3: Can it read Hindi or Marathi papers?
intro.a3: Yes. It reads printed papers in English, Hindi and Marathi. Handwriting is harder, so always check the numbers it finds.
intro.q4: What if my phone can’t speak my language?
intro.a4: Some phones don’t have a Hindi or Marathi voice. Saath will tell you, and you can still read everything on screen.
intro.q5: Will Saath tell me whether to take a loan?
intro.a5: No. Saath explains what the paper says and what it really costs. The choice is yours. Talk to someone you trust before you sign.
intro.q6: Who can see my name and password?
intro.a6: Only this phone. Saath has no online account, so nobody else can see them.
intro.madeP: Saath and Money Lab are built by The Skyward Project, a youth-led project on money skills, with the Interact Club of Pune Skyward. Our members also run free money workshops in schools and NGOs.
intro.ctaH: Read your next paper with Saath.
intro.ctaP: It takes less than a minute to start.
intro.footAdvice: Saath explains documents. It is not financial or legal advice.
intro.footMoneyLab: Money Lab by The Skyward Project, Interact Club of Pune Skyward
